blocks.raw: # Using Offers in Campaigns
blocks.text: Using Offers in Campaigns

blocks.raw:
You can use the offers created in Offer Management for other services such as campaigns, loyalty, or any third-party service. This article explains how to consume the available offers in Loyalty and Campaigns.\
Note: The offer once consumed by a service is not available to use for any other service.
blocks.text: You can use the offers created in Offer Management for other services such as campaigns, loyalty, or any third-party service. This article explains how to consume the available offers in Loyalty and Campaigns.Note: The offer once consumed by a service is not available to use for any other service.

blocks.raw: # Assign Offers in the DVS (bounce-back) campaign
blocks.text: Assign Offers in the DVS (bounce-back) campaign

blocks.raw: You can claim multiple offers in a DVS campaign and use them as needed based on the context. Offers claimed for a specific campaign are exclusively linked to that campaign and are not accessible for other outbound campaigns.
blocks.text: You can claim multiple offers in a DVS campaign and use them as needed based on the context. Offers claimed for a specific campaign are exclusively linked to that campaign and are not accessible for other outbound campaigns.

blocks.raw: Note: The DVS (Bounce Back) campaign is set up in the old campaign manager.
blocks.text: Note: The DVS (Bounce Back) campaign is set up in the old campaign manager.

blocks.raw: Refer to the following steps to use offers in the DVS campaign:

1. Navigate to **engage -> campaign.** Click on **[Open old campaign manager](https://eu.intouch.capillarytech.com/campaign/index#dashboard).**
2. Click on **New Action.**

blocks.raw: # Assign Offers in Outbound Campaign
blocks.text: Assign Offers in Outbound Campaign

blocks.raw:
You can claim only one offer in an outbound campaign. An offer claimed by an outbound campaign is exclusively associated with that campaign. The offer may or may not be issued to customers, but once it is claimed, it is not available for other outbound campaigns.\
Refer to the following to use offers in the outbound campaign:
